quest_003.description: A special Pokémon with a temporary Krampus Mark.

quest_004.description: One of the freed Pokémon chooses to remain with the player. Small chance of a Krampus Variant.

quest_012.description: Director Krampus's signature Pokémon, left behind when he fled.

team_krampus_insignia.name: Team Krampus Insignia
team_krampus_insignia.description: A black-and-red emblem: a horned Pokémon skull ringed by six pointed icicles. It was being used to mark certain Pokémon.

krampus_fragment.name: Krampus Fragment
krampus_fragment.description: A shard of the ancient Winterheart relic. It is unnaturally cold and hums faintly in the dark.

winterheart_shard.name: Winterheart Shard
winterheart_shard.description: One piece of the seal that holds something ancient beneath Frostpine. When the six bells ring, the heart will remember.
